title: Diversity of molecular karyotypes of 234 pediatric patients with autism spectrum disorder in chromosomal microarray analysis.
abstract: Retrospective CMA (CytoScan 750K and XON, hg19) on 234 children with ASD. Normal karyotype in 58.97%; single duplications 14.53%, single deletions 11.97%, multiple CNVs 12.82%. Diagnostic yield for pathogenic/likely-pathogenic CNVs 8.55%. Recurrent loci included 15q13.3 (OTUD7A, CHRNA7), 15q11.2 (NIPA1/2, CYFIP1, TUBGCP5), 22q11.21, 11q23.3 (KMT2A, TMEM25) and others. Hierarchical clustering separated three subgroups by VUS vs pathogenic burden. Replicates previously established ASD-associated CNV loci in an independent clinical cohort.
methods: Chromosomal microarray (CytoScan 750K, XON; hg19) on 234 ASD children; hierarchical clustering on principal components.
summary: CMA on 234 pediatric ASD cases; pathogenic/likely-pathogenic CNV yield 8.55%, replicating known ASD CNV loci (15q13.3, 15q11.2, 22q11.21) in an independent cohort. KMT2A (49-gene set) sits in a recurrent 11q23.3 duplication. Structural/dosage data relevant to the atlas; standard clinical CMA, no cell-type resolution.
